title: Rural health grant for kūpuna leaving the hospital
summary: A $390,000 rural health grant was announced on September 8. It will fund a program linking older adults leaving the hospital with a community health worker for 90 days. The funds must be committed by September 30th, a deadline set at the August 13 meeting for a new care program.

timeline.text: The rural health funds must be encumbered, or committed, by September 30th.
The program will link older adults leaving the hospital with a community health worker for 90 days.
